buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Warranty Successful bidder will have to ensure that adequate number of dedicated technical service personals / engineers are designated / deployed for attending to the Service Request in a time bound manner and for ensuring Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period, as per Service level agreement indicated in the relevant clause of the bid. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Product Authenticity The supplied All-in-One PC shall be brand new, unused and factory manufactured. Refurbished, repaired, reconditioned or second-hand equipment shall not be accepted.

The product shall be an officially supported commercial model of the respective OEM. The complete product configuration shall be verifiable through the OEM website. 2. Technical Compliance The offered product must comply with all technical specifications selected in the GeM bid. The bidder shall submit the official OEM product datasheet/brochure mentioning the offered model and con figuration. The supplied processor, RAM, SSD, display and operating system shall match the accepted bid specificatio ns. No hardware substitution or configuration downgrade shall be permitted without prior written approval of t he Buyer. 3. Operating System & Software Genuine, licensed Windows 11 Professional 64-bit shall be supplied as specified in the bid. The operating system shall be preloaded and activated. Necessary OEM drivers and firmware shall be installed. The system shall support TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot. No pirated, unauthorized or trial software shall be supplied as a substitute for licensed software. 4. OEM Warranty Minimum 03 years onsite comprehensive OEM warranty shall be provided, as selected in the bid. Warranty shall cover all major hardware components, including motherboard, processor, RAM, SSD, displa y, webcam and power components. 5. Delivery & Installation The equipment shall be delivered at the consignee location mentioned in the GeM contract. Transportation, insurance, packing and forwarding charges shall be included in the quoted price. Installation, commissioning and basic operational testing shall be completed by the seller wherever include d in the bid. All standard accessories, including keyboard, mouse, power cable and necessary connecting accessories, s hall be supplied. The system shall be delivered in original manufacturer packaging. 6. Inspection & Acceptance The consignee shall inspect the supplied equipment for physical damage and technical compliance. Processor, RAM, SSD, display, operating system and other essential configurations shall be verified. The product serial number and OEM warranty status shall be verified. Any defective, damaged or non-compliant equipment shall be replaced by the seller without additional cos t. 7. Documentation The successful bidder shall provide: OEM product datasheet. OEM warranty certificate. Individual equipment serial number list. Genuine operating system licensing/activation details.
Installation and commissioning report, wherever applicable. User manual and necessary product documentation. .
